question: In the year 2022, which of the following chess champions was beaten by a 16-year old Indian chess player Rameshbabu Praggnanandhaa?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Magnus Carlsen**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2022, 16-year-old Indian chess player Rameshbabu Praggnanandhaa defeated world chess champion Magnus Carlsen in an online tournament:
 
• When: February 22, 2022
 
• Where: In an online tournament with 16 elite players
 
• How it happened: Praggnanandhaa improved on his play from the first day of the tournament and avoided a draw against Carlsen 
 
• Praggnanandhaa was the youngest person to defeat Carlsen since he became world champion in 2013. 
 
• Praggnanandhaa has beaten Carlsen several times, including: 
 
• In the Champions Chess Tour in 2022 
 
• At the Superbet Grand Chess Tour in Warsaw, where he beat Carlsen for the first time in over-the-board chess 
 
• At the Norway Chess Tournament, where he defeated Carlsen in classical chess for the first time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Garry Kasparov
 
• A Russian chess grandmaster and former World Chess Champion. He was born in Baku, Soviet Union (now Azerbaijan) in 1963. In 1999, he achieved a peak FIDE chess rating of 2851, which was the highest recorded until 2013. 
 
• Magnus Carlsen
 
• A Norwegian chess grandmaster and the current world number one. He has won the World Chess Championship five times, the World Rapid Chess Championship five times, the World Blitz Chess Championship seven times, and the Chess World Cup Championship. 
 
• Bobby Fischer
 
• The first and only American world chess champion. He won 20 consecutive games against world-class opponents from 1970 to 1971. He is considered by many to be the most famous chess player ever. 
 
• Anatoly Karpov
 
• A Russian and former Soviet chess grandmaster and former World Chess Champion. He is also a politician.
